about: Reviewed allowlist for embedded path strings in the release payload (openspec/changes/release-build, spec 'Relocatable payload'). Strings only: load commands, install names and LC_RPATHs are never allowlisted. Each entry: file glob (payload-relative), a regex the whole string must match, and the reason it is harmless. Regexes avoid spelling a home path literally so repo.portable stays clean. {build_root} stands for the checkout the packaging run built in (escaped; release.py and release.no_abs_paths substitute it), so the build-tree defaults are accepted only for that folder (release-first-launch 5.1).

entries.reason: AzerothCore's compiled-in default for the SourceDirectory config key (revision.h _SOURCE_DIRECTORY = CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR); release mode sets SourceDirectory to the payload's sql/ folder (release-first-launch)
AzerothCore's compiled-in default for the BuildDirectory config key (revision.h _BUILD_DIRECTORY); informational only, never read at runtime
AzerothCore's compiled-in default for the MySQLExecutable config key (revision.h _MYSQL_EXECUTABLE); release mode sets MySQLExecutable to the payload's mysql/bin/mysql (release-first-launch)
AzerothCore's compiled-in default for the CMakeCommand config key (revision.h _CMAKE_COMMAND); informational only, never run

OpenSSL's compiled-in OPENSSLDIR/ENGINESDIR/MODULESDIR defaults (Homebrew build); the server loads no engines; it loads the legacy provider (RC4) from the bundled server/lib/legacy.dylib through OPENSSL_MODULES (stack.spawn_env), and OPENSSL_CONF points at HOME's empty openssl.cnf
OpenSSL's compiled-in OPENSSLDIR/ENGINESDIR/MODULESDIR defaults in Oracle's build; only read if those paths exist; Moonglade's mysqld runs with --no-defaults/--defaults-file and no TLS
Oracle MySQL's compiled-in basedir/datadir/plugin-dir/option-file defaults; Moonglade always passes --basedir and --datadir with --no-defaults or --defaults-file
Oracle libmysqlclient's compiled-in defaults (option files, plugin dir); the server connects over TCP with explicit settings and loads no client plugins
literal strings in Oracle's mysqld (test and upgrade fixtures from an Oracle developer's machine); never opened, they name files that exist on no player's Mac
CPython's frozen site/sysconfig docstrings and its configure-time prefix; python-build-standalone computes its real prefix from the executable's location
the launcher's PATH search list for finding python3 in the dev app (harness/app/launcher.m); a search list, not a load path; release-first-launch points it at the bundled python/
